name: Garden Trowel
description: A well-worn trowel with a handle polished by years of Bagshot Row soil.

name: Curry Comb
description: An ostler's iron comb for ponies, a little bent at one corner.

name: Hay Fork
description: A three-tined fork from a Staddle farmyard.

name: Copper Pennies
description: Small coins good for ale and bread from the Shire to Bree.

name: Buckland Horn
description: A battered signal horn of the kind Bucklanders blow when trouble comes over the Hedge.
